#!/bin/bash

# Atomic Test Name: T1005 - SQLite Dump
# Description:
#   This atomic test will dump the contents of a SQLite database.
#   The test will first check if the database is in the correct format, then it will dump the contents of the database.

# Check if the database is in the correct format

  # Dump the contents of the database
  sqlite3 gta.db.dump > gta_dump.sql
  echo "Database dumped successfully!"
else
  echo "Database is not in the correct format."
fi

#!/bin/bash
# SQLite database dump tool
# Author: Red Canary
# Version: 1.0
# Description: This script will dump the contents of a SQLite database to the console.
# Usage: sqlite_dump.sh <database_file>

# Check if the database file exists
if [! -f "$1" ]; then
  echo "Error: Database file not found."
  exit 1
fi

# Dump the database
sqlite3 "$1" ".dump" | sed's/;/\n/g' | sed's/INSERT INTO/INSERT INTO\n/g'

chris@speedlab-ml-3:~$
